title: Watercolour Cottage by a Stream
tests: Whether the output visibly follows a named illustration style while preserving the requested scene.

judge.summary: A polished square watercolour illustration clearly depicts a little stone cottage beside a stream with soft green hills behind it and no text.

must_haves.item: The image visibly resembles watercolour, with translucent washes and softly blended edges rather than a photographic or 3D-rendered finish.
must_haves.why: Translucent green and blue washes, softly blended vegetation, and irregular painted edges visibly establish a watercolour finish.

must_haves.item: A little stone cottage is a clearly recognizable subject.
must_haves.why: The central cottage has clearly depicted stone walls, a slate roof, chimneys, windows, and a front door.

must_haves.item: A stream runs beside the cottage.
must_haves.why: A rock-lined stream flows alongside the cottage and across the foreground.

must_haves.item: Soft green hills appear behind the cottage.
must_haves.why: Layered, gently rounded green hills fill the background behind the cottage.

must_haves.item: The composition is square and contains no text.
must_haves.why: The image is square, and no text is visible.
